# AgentSteps

A live log of what an agent is doing, step by step, so people can follow the work and step in when it needs them.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.AgentSteps` · AI patterns

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.AgentSteps steps={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.AgentSteps" steps="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

A live, step-by-step log of what an agent is doing. Status is an icon plus a word.
